terra.problem: Herod's orders are in the same verse as his rage, not the next verse.
The passage does not say that the angel who appears after Herod's death is the same angel who appeared earlier.
The angel says those seeking the Child's life are dead, not that all danger is over.
The passage does not say the dreams happened at bedtime or give the contents of the third warning.
The line about Bethsaida being a 'Galilee-sounding name' jokes about how a place name sounds.
